senses.zh_definition: 爱德华多：西班牙语及葡萄牙语传统中的男性名字，对应英语 Edward。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name used in Spanish and Portuguese, corresponding to English Edward.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi lelaki dalam bahasa Sepanyol dan Portugis yang sepadan dengan nama Edward dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas，正常书写为 Eduardo；小写词头沿用输入索引。这里的马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 官方释义；status 按指定模式保留，不表示已核实 DBP 收录。资料包未提供音节及爪夷文，保留 null。搭配为自然示例，未作频率认证。[Eduardo 名称资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/eduardo)

etymology.historical_story: Eduardo is the Spanish and Portuguese counterpart of Edward. Its deeper ancestry lies in Old English Eadweard, combining elements associated with wealth and guarding. This history explains the traditional interpretation 'guardian of wealth'; it does not describe a modern bearer's character or occupation. In Malay, the name is retained as a personal name rather than translated. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/edward)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Eduardo 与熟悉的 Edward 配成一组：爱德华多是人名。读音跟随本人语言，不按马来语词缀拆分。
